licenses.text:
Η Καινή Διαθήκη, eBible.org, https://ebible.org/grcsr/

The edition's own statement of rights (from eBible.org's page for this translation, https://ebible.org/grcsr/copyright.htm):
> Solid Rock Greek New Testament, Scholar's Edition
> Public Domain
> Language: Ελληνικά (Greek, Ancient)
> Translation by: Robinson and Pierpont
> Contributor: Joey McCollum and Stephen Brown
> 2026-10-13

Why this is public domain:
Text: the Solid Rock Greek New Testament by Joey McCollum and Stephen L. Brown (both living, United States), "very close in character to the Robinson-Pierpont text" (its README). Their own words: "This work is hereby released into the public domain. ... Likewise, we hereby release into the public domain the introduction, appendices, and textual apparatus" (its LICENSE). Its base: The Robinson-Pierpont Byzantine Textform's notice reads: "This compilation is Copyright (C) 2018 by Maurice A. Robinson. Anyone is permitted to copy ... All rights to this text are released to everyone" (https://byzantinetext.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/03/robinson-pierpont-2018-gnt-edition.pdf; the 2005 edition's notice, https://byzantinetext.com/?p=111, is the same in substance). The maintainer's decision (2026-10-16): a copyright line beside a full release of all rights counts as a public-domain dedication. Editors: Maurice A. Robinson (living, United States) and William G. Pierpont.

The read-aloud archive holds the Bible text chapter by chapter as plain text, a front file, the copyright page (copr.htm, left out of the source), and eBible.org's signing key (keys.asc, left out).

Sources of these facts: eBible.org's details page (https://ebible.org/details.php?id=grcsr), the edition's copyright page (https://ebible.org/grcsr/copyright.htm), https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jjmccollum/solid-rock-gnt/master/LICENSE; https://github.com/jjmccollum/solid-rock-gnt; https://byzantinetext.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/03/robinson-pierpont-2018-gnt-edition.pdf.

held_out_by.note: eBible's chapter files, <code>_<NNN>_<BOOK>_<CC>_read.txt, are held out by book and chapter, so the same chapter is held out in every translation at once (maintainer's decision, 2026-10-23)

note: eBible.org rebuilds this zip often; the checksum covers the files inside, so a rebuild with the same text still matches.
